entities.summary: Regev Fanan is a former Israeli professional basketball player who is currently the athletic trainer for Maccabi Tel Aviv. Fanan played most of his professional career with Maccabi, and also played for Hapoel Galil Elyon and Ironi Ramat Gan. He is the son of Moni Fanan.
